listen_address.description: IP address (IPv4 or IPv6) on which glome-login will listen for incoming connections.

listen_port.description: TCP port number on which glome-login will accept connections.

use_tls.description: Enable or disable TLS encryption for all client connections.

tls_cert_chain.description: Path to the TLS certificate chain file (server cert + intermediate certs).

tls_private_key.description: Path to the TLS private key file.

tls_ca_bundle.description: Path to the trusted CA certificate bundle used for client certificate verification (if mutual TLS is enabled).

max_connections.description: Maximum number of concurrent client connections the server will accept.

session_timeout.description: Idle session timeout in seconds; sessions expire after this period of inactivity.

worker_threads.description: Number of worker threads to handle login/authentication requests concurrently.

debug.description: Enable verbose debug logging for troubleshooting.

log_file.description: Path to the log file. Leave empty to log to stderr only.

auth_providers.description: List of authentication backend providers to use. Each provider defines a backend (e.g., LDAP, OAuth, local file).

name.description: Unique name for this auth provider (e.g., 'ldap-main', 'oauth-github').

endpoint.description: URL or URI for the provider endpoint (e.g., 'ldap://ldap.example.com:389', 'https://oauth.example.com').

options.description: Additional key-value configuration options specific to the provider (e.g., bind_dn, client_id, timeout_ms).
